title: Orphan Claim — Notifier + Left-nav (Loss → Summary)
walkthroughSteps: Apply an AC — banner pushes FNOL state into orphan path
Land on /fnol/skeleton-create — left nav shows 2 steps (Loss / Summary)
Fill Client + Reason on Loss page
Optional: fill Broker / Insured / Internal notifier free-text fields
Review Loss + Notifier blocks, click 'Create' to register the skeleton claim

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Notifier section uses a Broker / Insured / Internal radio (Loss Location pattern)
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: On the **Loss information** page of the orphan flow, a *radio toggle* picks the notifier type (`Broker` / `Insured` / `Internal`) — only the relevant input renders below. Picking **Broker** opens the *Search broker* modal (Name management — IPM-backed). Picking **Insured** or **Internal** shows a single free-text input.

setup.description: Push FNOL state into orphan path so the user lands on Loss page directly

preconditions.text: Left navigation pane shows 2 steps: Loss (active) and Summary
Notifier section visible with 3 optional free-text fields

expectedUI.description: Loss information page with Notifier radio + dynamic field
visualCues: Section heading 'Notifier' between Reason and Notes
Radio group: Broker / Insured / Internal (Broker default)
Broker selected: 'Search broker' button opens the Name management modal (filters + table + Add Selected)
Insured / Internal selected: single labelled free-text input
Selected broker shows as a card with Legal name + IPM id + Change/Remove actions

howToTest.trigger: Scroll the Loss form, observe the Notifier section
howToTest.expectedResult: Three optional text fields render with placeholder text

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Left navigation shows Loss / Summary for orphan flow
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: The FNOL **left navigation** shows two steps for the orphan path: `Loss` (active on /fnol/skeleton-create) and `Summary` (active on /fnol/skeleton-summary). Re-uses the existing FnolStepperComponent.

setup.description: Same as AC-01 — orphan path active

preconditions.text: Sidebar stepper shows 'Loss' active and 'Summary' pending
Clicking Next from Loss → Summary marks Loss completed and Summary active

expectedUI.description: Sidebar stepper with two visible steps

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Loss page button reads 'Next' (was 'Create skeleton claim')
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: The footer button on the Loss page is **Next** — it does *not* submit the claim, only navigates to the Summary page. Submission happens on Summary.

preconditions.text: Loss page primary button is labelled 'Next'
Clicking Next does not create the claim — it navigates to Summary

visualCues: No spinner on Next — pure navigation

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Summary page reviews Loss + Notifier and creates on Confirm
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: The Summary page shows two read-only review blocks (`Loss` + `Notifier`) and a **Create** button that submits the skeleton claim. Success state shows a banner with the new claim ID and a 'Go to dashboard' action.

preconditions.text: Summary page shows 'Loss' card with Client / Reason / Notes
Summary page shows 'Notifier' card with Broker / Insured / Internal notifier
Clicking Create registers the skeleton and shows success banner with claim ID

visualCues: Info banner: 'Review the details below. Click Create to register…'
Loss card with 3 fields (Client / Reason / Notes)
Notifier card with 3 fields (Broker / Insured / Internal notifier)

howToTest.expectedResult: Success banner shows the new skeleton claim ID; toast 'Skeleton claim created'
